product.title: Caral, The Oldest Civilization in the Americas:Day Trip from Lima

description.text: In Lima, this small-group day follows the Supe Valley to the Caral Archaeological Zone, then continues to Barranca for the published beach-town stop. Round-trip transport, site admission, a bilingual guide, and lunch are listed so the group can stay with the pyramids rather than assembling highway and ticket logistics independently. The guide covers unmarked ruins at what the product page calls the oldest center of civilization in the Americas. Pickup is published from multiple Lima locations. The format suits visitors who want a guided Indigenous-history day without self-driving the north coast. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Lima, and the itinerary stays on the Caral Archaeological Zone and Barranca that shape this outing rather than a Pachacamac half-day add-on.
